description: A label line (`Total: 42`) at a body top is a label on a statement that is not a loop: it compiles nothing, so it is E-UNQUOTED-DISPLAY-TEXT (the native front end used to drop it silently).
rationale: §40.8 S441 bullet (round 5): body-top code that does nothing is a compile error; a label is meaningful only as a break/continue target of a loop.
